patch.value: Report progress gains with evidence revisions across standup windows

Deliver a read-only typed SDK and compact CLI projection of passing test facts, explicitly accepted criterion evidence and declared readiness changes. Reuse SDK verified history and canonical item reads; preserve lifecycle activity as separate counts.
A status-only edit never appears as verified progress; Each reported gain names its evidence revision; The same evidence is not counted twice across reporting windows
